scripts.start: tsc && OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=isuride-node OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=service.namespace=isuride,deployment.environment.name=training OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=otlp OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317 OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL=grpc OTEL_NODE_ENABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=http,mysql2 node --import ./otel-hook.mjs --import @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node/register dist/main.js
scripts.dev: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=isuride-node OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=console OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER=none OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=none OTEL_NODE_ENABLED_INSTRUMENTATIONS=http,mysql2 tsx --import ./otel-hook.mjs --import @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node/register watch src/main.ts
